evals.prompt: Write the PR description for my branch in /tmp/eval-pr-desc-1-ws. It's feat/auth-add-refresh-tokens, three commits, and no PR exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the branch diff with the three-dot form against origin/main plus the commit subjects, then proposes a Conventional Commit title such as 'feat(auth): add refresh token rotation' under 72 characters. Body contains a short Summary and a Trade-offs section drawn from the diff; Follow-ups is omitted because the diff shows nothing deferred. Nothing ran in this session, so Verification is omitted too and the report says so; the agent does not run the test suite itself to fill it. No test plan, no session narrative, no release-type opinion. Agent shows the full title and body and, if it creates the PR at all, creates it as a draft.
expectations: Agent runs git diff with the three-dot form (origin/main...HEAD), not the two-dot form
Agent reads the commit subjects on the branch in addition to the diff
Proposed title is a Conventional Commit subject with a scope taken from the primary package touched
Proposed title is under 72 characters and contains no emoji or issue number
Body contains a Summary section written from the diff rather than a file-by-file change log
Body contains no '## Test Plan' section and no how-to-test checklist
Body has no Verification section, because nothing ran in the session, and the report says it was omitted for that reason
Agent does NOT run the test suite or the gate itself to fill Verification
Body contains no narration of how the change was arrived at during the session
Body contains no opinion about release type, version bump, or whether it is safe to release
Body contains no Claude session link, model name, AI identifier, or emoji
Sections with nothing to say are omitted entirely rather than left empty or filled with filler
If the agent opens a PR, it uses --draft

evals.prompt: The approach has changed, so can you update the PR description? It's PR #412 in /tmp/eval-pr-desc-2-ws. We dropped the polling and went with a webhook instead.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs 'gh pr view 412' to read the existing title and body, then regenerates both from the current diff of the PR head branch rather than patching the old text. Verification bullets in the old body that cite runs on the polling head are dropped, since they proved another tree; the section is rebuilt from runs on the current head or omitted. It prints the existing title and body next to the proposed ones, names what is being removed (including the now-stale polling description), asks for confirmation, and only after a yes runs 'gh pr edit 412' with a body file.
expectations: Agent reads the existing PR body with gh pr view before writing anything
Agent regenerates the body from the current diff instead of editing the old text in place
Agent uses the three-dot diff form against the base branch
Stale claims about the old polling approach do not survive into the new body
Verification bullets from runs on the earlier head do not survive into the new body
Agent shows a before and after of the title and body
Agent names what is being removed from the old body
Agent asks for confirmation before running gh pr edit and waits for a yes
Agent does NOT run gh pr edit before that confirmation
New body still contains only Summary, Trade-offs, Follow-ups and Verification, omitting any that have nothing real to say

evals.prompt: Update the PR description for /tmp/eval-pr-desc-3-ws and record the decision to temporarily ignore the advisory. The branch adds GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz to the audit ignore list because the fix only landed in a major version of the transitive dependency.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the diff, sees the advisory id added to the audit ignore list, and records the time-boxed decision in the body: what was ignored, why it is being ignored now, and the concrete condition that should trigger a revisit, such as the upstream major release landing. It does not editorialise about whether shipping with the advisory ignored is acceptable, and it adds no security-review commentary. Shows before and after, asks, then edits.
expectations: Agent identifies the advisory ignore from the diff rather than from the conversation
Body states which advisory was ignored, by id
Body states why it was ignored now
Body states a concrete revisit condition, such as an upstream release or version, not 'later'
The temporary decision appears in Summary or Trade-offs, not only as a bare Follow-ups bullet
Body contains no security-review commentary or threat assessment
Body contains no judgement about whether the change is safe to release or what version bump it warrants
Agent shows a before and after and asks before running gh pr edit

evals.prompt: Please be more succinct in the PR body for /tmp/eval-pr-desc-4-ws, and do not put a test plan in it. It's a fix branch for the CSV parser.
evals.expected_output: Agent writes a short body from the diff with a Summary of a few lines and drops Trade-offs and Follow-ups if the diff shows nothing to put there. It produces no test plan, no how-to-test checklist, and no 'how I tested this' bullets anywhere, including under another heading. If runs from this session exist, Verification keeps one line per run with command, head and exit code and is not cut for brevity; if nothing ran, it is omitted. Title is a Conventional Commit subject such as 'fix(parser): handle empty rows in CSV reader'. Before and after shown if a PR body already exists, and confirmation requested before any edit of that existing body; a draft gh pr create needs no ask.
expectations: Final body contains no '## Test Plan' section
Final body contains no how-to-test checklist, test steps, or 'how I tested' bullets under any heading
Any Verification section present lists only commands that ran in the session, each with an exit code, and is not padded or invented to fill the heading
Summary is a short paragraph or a few bullets, not a per-file change log
Trade-offs and Follow-ups are omitted rather than filled with filler when the diff shows nothing for them
Title is a Conventional Commit subject under 72 characters with a scope from the touched package
Agent sources the body from the diff, not from the session transcript
Agent asks for confirmation before any gh pr edit of an existing body, and does not ask before a draft gh pr create

evals.prompt: ship is calling you in create mode for /tmp/eval-pr-desc-5-ws. Branch feat/ledger-add-export was pushed as a1b2c3d, and ship proved the committed tree is the one verify ran on. The verify block says pnpm typecheck exit 0, pnpm lint exit 0, pnpm test exit 0 with '142 passed', and build has no script. An earlier pnpm lint before a hook fix is labelled 'working tree before commit', exit 1. Hand back the title and body.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the three-dot diff and the commit subjects, writes the title and the Summary, Trade-offs and Follow-ups from the diff, and fills Verification from the verify block it was handed: one bullet each for pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm test, each naming a1b2c3d and its exit code, with '142 passed' copied as the test result line, because ship proved the run was on that commit. The earlier lint run keeps its 'working tree before commit' label and exit 1 and gets no sha. No bullet for build, which did not run. It does not run any of the commands itself and does not cite CI. It hands the title and body back to ship without running gh pr create, and the report lists the bullets and what each ran on.
expectations: Agent reads the diff with the three-dot form and the commit subjects before writing
Verification contains one bullet per command in the verify block, each naming the command, the head a1b2c3d and the exit code
The test bullet copies '142 passed' from the output rather than saying 'passes'
The earlier lint run appears labelled 'working tree before commit' with exit 1 and carries no sha
Verification has no bullet for build, which had no script and did not run
Agent does NOT run typecheck, lint or test itself to produce the section
Verification does not cite CI or claim CI passed
Agent hands the title and body back to ship and does NOT run gh pr create
Report names the Verification bullets and what each ran on
